items.prompt: Close-up portrait of the head, neck and shoulders of a Hullbreaker, a huge alien hunting beast from a cold heavy-gravity world, hunched forward with the heavy rounded bulk of a great predator: a tall shoulder hump, a thick short neck, a broad barrel body and thick forearms ending in heavy curved claws. A thick coarse shaggy mane of black fur covers the hump, the shoulders, the neck and the back of the head and frames the face; the arms are thick dark leathery hide with coarse hair. The head is low, broad and blunt, sunk into the mane between the shoulders. The face is bare living hide armoured with thick matte bony plates of dark grey-brown horn, like the scales of a pangolin or the shell of a tortoise, rough, ridged and chipped, dark leathery skin showing in the creases between them. The jaw is split down the middle of the chin into two plated halves hinged at the sides, the left and right halves spread apart sideways in a snarl, a gap down the middle of the chin, rows of small sharp teeth along the inner edge of each half. A row of four small glowing red eyes sits in one straight line across the plated brow, and rows of small dark heat-sensing pits run along the cheeks below them. A heavy scrap armour harness of rusty riveted hull plates from other ships and thick leather straps covers the chest and belly, hung with machine trophies: a cracked sensor lens, a torn circuit board, a bent antenna. Close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of a Glasswright, a tall slender living alien of soft flesh that grows glass inside its body. Its long neck, throat, shoulders and hands are soft milky translucent living flesh like the body of a jellyfish, faintly pulsing, with pale pink strands of sinew and muscle visible inside; fine threads of clear glass and small faceted crystal inlays are grown into the flesh in flowing lines like veins, and light runs along the glass threads like fibre optics and splits into rainbow colours where it leaves the crystal inlays. It wears a layered robe of crystal plates and silver mirror-thread fabric, open at the throat. Soft bands of coloured light pulse across the facet of its head and down the glass threads of its neck as it speaks.
